title: 第九章 两条街的战争第十章 茉莉花和生意经
lines: 第二天一早，沈南枝去邮局取了个包裹。
包裹是从广州寄来的，里面是她半个月前托人从那边带的天然石料——几块紫水晶、粉晶和玛瑙原石，品质比她在县城买的那些好得多。她拆开包装，把石头一块一块拿出来，对着阳光看。
紫水晶透亮，里面有一丝丝棉絮，在光线下闪着细碎的光。粉晶颜色淡淡的，像春天的桃花。玛瑙的红不艳不暗，刚好。
这些石头她要自己切，自己磨，自己做成一整套高端产品。
从邮局出来，她顺路去了趟菜市场。买了两条鲫鱼、一把青菜、半斤豆腐，又买了几个西红柿和鸡蛋。桂姨昨天说想吃鱼，珠珠也说想吃鸡蛋羹。
菜市场人多，挤来挤去的。她在鱼摊前挑鱼的时候，一只手突然伸过来，把她挑好的那条鱼拿走了。
她抬头一看，是白若溪。
白若溪穿着一件淡紫色的短袖，头发扎成马尾，脸上没化妆，看着比平时年轻几岁。她把那条鱼拎起来看了看，又放回去了。
“不好意思，没看见你。”她说，语气轻飘飘的，嘴角带着笑。
沈南枝没理她，重新挑了一条，递给老板称。
白若溪也不走，站在旁边，看着老板杀鱼，突然开口：“南枝，昨天我跟你说的事，你考虑了吗？”
“什么事？”
“咱们合作的事。你的设计加上我的渠道，京海市场可以做大。”
沈南枝付了钱，拎着鱼转身就走。
白若溪跟在后面：“你就不想听听我的计划？”
“不想。”
“你这人怎么这样？”白若溪的声音提高了半度，但很快又压下去了，“我是好心好意。”
沈南枝停下来，转过身，看着她。
“白若溪，你在中山路开店，我在城西开店，咱俩各做各的生意，井水不犯河水。你非要跟我搅和在一起干什么？”
白若溪张了张嘴，没说出话。
“你是不是觉得，没有你，我就活不下去？”沈南枝说，“还是你觉得，不把我踩下去，你心里就不舒服？”
白若溪的脸红了一下，又白了。
“你误会了，我只是——”
“我没有误会。”沈南枝打断她，“你做的那些事，你自己心里清楚。在龙城的时候，你让王秀兰翻我屋子，让赵大勇砸我摊子。到了京海，你又来搞什么‘合作’。你当我傻？”
周围买菜的人都停下来看她们。白若溪的脸涨得通红，嘴唇哆嗦了两下，转身走了。走得很快，半高跟皮鞋踩在水泥地上，嗒嗒嗒嗒的，像机关枪。
沈南枝拎着鱼，继续逛。
她注意到白若溪走的方向不是回中山路，而是往城东去了。城东有个小区，住着不少机关单位的人。沈南枝想起来，原书里白若溪那个当科长的朋友就在城东住。
她没多想，买完菜回去了。
回到店里，桂姨已经把柜台擦了一遍，货也摆好了。珠珠坐在柜台后面的小板凳上，拿着沈南枝给她的一串旧珠子在拆了穿，穿了拆，玩得不亦乐乎。
“姨，今天我要去趟市场，看看有没有新的材料。”沈南枝把菜放下，擦了擦手。
“去吧，店里我看着。”
沈南枝骑上自行车，去了华东小商品交易中心。
市场里还是一样热闹，人挤人。她先去了工艺品区，转了转几个饰品摊位，发现有一家新开的，卖的东西跟她的“京海之春”系列很像——也是绸缎做的花朵，也是淡粉色和淡绿色，甚至连包装盒都差不多。
她拿起来看了看，绸缎的料子不一样，颜色发乌，花朵缝得歪歪扭扭的，线头都没藏好。价格比她便宜一块钱。
“老板，这个是你自己做的？”她问摊主。
摊主是个三十多岁的女人，烫着卷发，涂着红嘴唇，说话嗓门很大：“对啊，我自己设计的，好看吧？”
content_en:
Early the next morning, Shen Nanzhi went to the post office to pick up a package.
The package was sent from Guangzhou, and inside it was the natural stones she had asked someone to bring from there half a month ago - several pieces of amethyst, rose quartz and agate rough stones, the quality of which was much better than the ones she bought in the county. She unpacked it, took out the stones one by one, and looked at the sun.
The amethyst is translucent, with a trace of cotton inside, shimmering in the light. Rose quartz has a light color, like peach blossoms in spring. The red color of agate is neither bright nor dark, just right.
She has to cut these stones by herself, grind them by herself, and make a complete set of high-end products by herself.
After leaving the post office, she stopped by the vegetable market. I bought two crucian carp, a handful of vegetables, half a pound of tofu, and a few tomatoes and eggs. Aunt Gui said she wanted to eat fish yesterday, and Zhuzhu also said she wanted to eat egg custard.
There are many people in the vegetable market, and they are crowded. When she was choosing fish in front of the fish stall, a hand suddenly reached out and took away the fish she had chosen.
She looked up and saw that it was Bai Ruoxi.
Bai Ruoxi was wearing a lavender short-sleeved shirt, her hair was tied into a ponytail, and she had no makeup on her face. She looked a few years younger than usual. She picked up the fish, looked at it, and put it back.
"Sorry, I didn't see you." She said with a light tone and a smile on her lips.
Shen Nanzhi ignored her, picked another one, and handed it to the boss to weigh.
Bai Ruoxi didn't leave. She stood nearby, watching the boss kill the fish, and suddenly said: "Nanzhi, have you considered what I told you yesterday?"
"What's the matter?"
"It's about our cooperation. With your design and my channels, the Jinghai market can be expanded."
Shen Nanzhi paid the money, turned around and left with the fish.
Bai Ruoxi followed: "Don't you want to hear my plan?"
"I don't want to."
"Why are you like this?" Bai Ruoxi's voice raised half a degree, but quickly suppressed it again, "I mean well."
Shen Nanzhi stopped, turned around and looked at her.
"Bai Ruoxi, you open a store on Zhongshan Road, and I open a store in the west of the city. We each do our own business, and we don't interfere with each other. Why do you have to get involved with me?"
Bai Ruoxi opened her mouth but said nothing.
"Do you think that I can't live without you?" Shen Nanzhi said, "Or do you think that if you don't step on me, you will feel uncomfortable?"
Bai Ruoxi's face turned red and turned pale again.
"You misunderstood, I just-"
"I didn't misunderstand." Shen Nanzhi interrupted her, "You know what you did. When you were in Longcheng, you asked Wang Xiulan to turn over my house and Zhao Dayong to destroy my stall. When you arrived in Jinghai, what kind of 'cooperation' did you come to do again? Do you think I'm stupid?"
People shopping around stopped to look at them. Bai Ruoxi's face turned red, her lips trembled twice, and she turned around and left. He walked very fast, and his semi-high-heeled leather shoes clicked on the cement floor like a machine gun.
Shen Nanzhi carried the fish and continued shopping.
She noticed that Bai Ruoxi was not heading back to Zhongshan Road, but to the east of the city. There is a community in the east of the city where many people from government agencies live. Shen Nanzhi remembered that Bai Ruoxi's friend who was the section chief in the original book lived in the east of the city.
She didn't think much and went back after buying groceries.
Back in the store, Aunt Gui had wiped the counter and put the goods on display. Zhuzhu was sitting on the small bench behind the counter, taking a string of old beads that Shen Nanzhi gave her and taking them apart, wearing them and having a great time.
"Auntie, I'm going to the market today to see if there are any new ingredients." Shen Nanzhi put down the vegetables and wiped his hands.
"Go ahead, I'll watch the store."
Shen Nanzhi rode his bicycle and went to the East China Small Commodity Trading Center.
The market is still lively and crowded. She first went to the arts and crafts area, walked around a few jewelry stalls, and found a newly opened one that sold items that were very similar to her "Spring in Jinghai" series - flowers made of silk and satin, also light pink and light green, and even the packaging boxes were similar.
She picked it up and looked at it. The material of the satin was different, the color was dark, the flowers were sewn crookedly, and the threads were not well hidden. The price is a dollar cheaper than hers.
"Boss, did you make this yourself?" she asked the stall owner.
The stall owner is a woman in her thirties, with curly hair, red lips, and a loud voice: "Yes, I designed it myself, doesn't it look good?"
title_en: Chapter 9 The War of Two Streets Chapter 10 Jasmine and Business
